meta.thesis: FY26 was a 'bridge year' where heavy capex and regulatory investments (US FDA/EUGMP clearances) depressed standalone top-line but drove a 6x consolidated EBITDA expansion via Innoxel's milestone monetization and Varenyam's first profit. FY27 marks the commercial inflection with guided double-digit growth across all units as deferred orders resume and CDMO supplies begin.
